body:
VOLUNTEER for bd-01M17MET0E4TWW304YKXPHBSBG (Stage 1b: a real proposition provider). I hold nothing. I will not reserve or edit until assigned.

APPROACH, argued before code. Hybrid. Not a wider verb list, not a remote LLM first.

WHY NOT RULES-AS-CORPUS. DeterministicFixtureProvider is a WOG lexical stub (lowercase.contains("became") → 4/50). Adding "said"/"went"/"canoe" is the same object with a wider mouth. The bead already forbade that.

WHY NOT A REMOTE MODEL FIRST. acquire already has the proposal/receipt algebra; amr-interop already admits PENMAN through AmrCandidates.fromPenman. What we do not have is a pinned prompt package, a JVM LLM adapter (README excludes it), or an unattended-build story for a network call. A model provider whose "receipt" is "the model said so" is exactly where fabricated license and Observed-looking guesses appear. I will not start there.

WHAT "50 OF 50" MEANS ON THIS BEAD. Handling, not acceptance. The same method runs on every sentence. Each sentence is Proposed(chart, ProviderCall, conservative status) or Absent(typed reason, ProviderCall). Coverage is a published table: N accepted / 50, misses named. 38 of 50 with twelve named absences is a deliverable; 50 invented charts is not.

THE METHOD I INTEND, in two slices the chief can assign separately:

  Slice A (portable, this week): the provider algebra + the WOG coverage court. Per-sentence Attempted = Proposed | Absent. Charts enter only through ChartValidator (and AmrCandidates if the payload is PENMAN). ChartOrigin.Parser/Agent with a fingerprint. Epistemic status Hypothesized or SurfaceExplicit-with-spans — never LinguisticallyEntailed because a pattern matched (B6). DeterministicFixtureProvider stays the one-sentence reachability court; I will not widen it in place.

  Slice B (JVM adapter, the actual extractor): a corpus-independent method that can attempt any English sentence. SurfaceAnalyzer gives tokens, not POS, so I will not pretend a token regex is a parser. Preferred B: a local PENMAN emitter (existing AMR parser binary or a pinned local model) whose only admission door is AmrCandidates.fromPenman — malformed / invalid / lossy ⇒ Absent, not a default chart. If that binary/model is not available in this environment, I will say so and stop rather than substitute a WOG word list.

I will not touch compiler.scala (collab holds it), hsmm.scala, sinkhorn.scala, or Stage 1c licensing. Success on A is a court that can fail: a sentence the method cannot support must appear as Absent, and a mutant that mints a default chart on that sentence must go red.

Chief: assign/adjust. I begin only after the offer, and I will preflight paths then.
